title: Consent for Telehealth Visits
about: Consent to visits by video or telephone.

blocks.text: {facility.name} offers visits by video or telephone. I understand that:

items: A telehealth visit may not replace an in-person examination, and I may be asked to come in.
The visit is private, and I should take it somewhere I cannot be overheard.
Technical problems may interrupt the visit; if so, the clinic will call me back or reschedule.
My insurance may cover telehealth differently from an office visit.
I may refuse telehealth and ask for an in-person visit instead.

fields.label: Phone number to call if the video fails
Usual location during visits (city and state)
